title: Co-immunoprecipitation of Platelet Factor 4 and RANTES from human platelets
protocol: Obtain fresh platelets from the local bloodbank or from healthy volunteers by venipuncture.
Isolate and wash platelets using standard methods such as differential centrifugation.
Take an equivalent of platelets to 20 mL of blood as starting material, which corresponds to approximately 500x10^7 platelets.
Pellet the washed platelets for 10 minutes at 2000g and suspend in 1 mL of lysis buffer on ice.
Sonicate the platelet lysate three times for 1 second each at 25% amplitude on ice.
Centrifuge the lysate for 10 minutes at 4,000g (4°C) and remove the floating lipid plug using a MACS pre-separation filter.
Centrifuge the lysate for 20 minutes at 20,000g (4°C) and retain the supernatant.
Add 100 μl of protein G magnetic beads and incubate on ice for 30 minutes to pre-clear the solution.
Remove aggregates from the magnetic beads by centrifuging for 30 seconds at 20,000g.
Prepare a molecular MACS column by priming with 200 μl of lysis buffer and pass the lysate over the column to collect precleared lysate.
Split the precleared lysate into two equal portions.
Add 2 μg of specific anti-CCL5 antibody to one portion.
Add 2 μg of specific anti-CXCL4 antibody to another portion.
Add corresponding non-specific control antibody to a third portion.
Mix each portion thoroughly.
Add 50 μl of protein G magnetic beads to each portion.
Mix again and incubate on ice for at least 30 minutes.
Prepare molecular MACS columns by priming with 200 μl of lysis buffer.
Discard the flowthrough after priming.
Mix antibody/bead-treated lysates thoroughly.
Pipette treated lysates into molecular MACS columns, using one column per portion.
Allow columns to empty by gravity flow at ambient temperature.
Wash columns three times with lysis buffer.
Wash columns once with 20 mM Tris pH 7.5.
Discard the flowthrough after each wash.
Warm SDS sample buffer at 95°C in the meantime.
Add 20 μl of hot SDS sample buffer to elute CXCL4/CCL5 complex.
Wait for five minutes after adding SDS sample buffer.
Collect fluid exiting the column in a clean tube.
Add an additional 50 μl of hot SDS sample buffer.
Collect fluid exiting the column again in a separate clean tube.
Store samples at this point if necessary.
Analyze samples on a ready gradient gel (8-16%).
Blot onto nitrocellulose using standard methods.
Block with polymer-based Roti Block and milk mixture for at least one hour at room temperature.
Mix biotinylated antibodies listed in the Reagents section with StreptABC complex.
Strip the blot using stripping buffer.
Analyse the stripped blot using another biotinylated antibody.
